close_reason: Landed in fcda7dc. Moved serde_json from [dependencies] to [dev-dependencies] in Cargo.toml. All serde_json references are inside #[cfg(test)] modules or under tests/. Workspace check/clippy/test all clean. Note: when CidCapability lands (finding .6) it will need serde_json::Map for the extras field per workspace policy, at which point serde_json moves back to [dependencies] as a one-line edit.
description: crate-jmap-cid-types/Cargo.toml:16 declares serde_json = { workspace = true } as a runtime dep, but grep src/digest.rs shows serde_json is referenced only inside #[cfg(test)] mod tests (round-trip JSON tests). The public API surface is Sha256 + error types — no serde_json::Value, no serde_json::Map, no extras field. Effect on downstream consumers: every crate that pulls in jmap-cid-types forces serde_json into its compile graph and binary, even though jmap-cid-types itself only needs serde at runtime. PLAN.md §'Type-design constraints' (lines 134-148) notes the future CidCapability would need serde_json::Map for the extras field — at that point serde_json moves back to [dependencies], which is fine. But today the dep is dev-only. Fix: move serde_json under [dev-dependencies]. The four cargo gates (fmt/clippy/test/doc) all still pass — verified by reading the current call sites.
title: Cargo.toml: serde_json should be in [dev-dependencies], not [dependencies]
